newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Edifer, Engil discuss integration of strategies.
newsitem.headline: Edifer, Engil discuss integration of strategies.

text.p: Portuguese construction group Engil said it had signed an agreement with another builder Edifer to start talks on the integration of the two groups' business strategies.
It said in a statement that the form the integration would take and a starting date would be decided during the talks.

"A preliminary agreement has been signed between Engil SGPS and Edifer SGPS SA that foresees the start of talks between the two companies, with a view to the harmonisation and integration of the business strategies of the two groups," the statement said.

Earlier, the Financial Markets Committee (CMVM) suspended trade in Engil and another Portuguese builder, A.Silva & Silva, after a press report said that Edifer may form an alliance with another Portuguese builder, possibly Engil or A.Silva & Silva.
